Title: TFGTRS-4609 - Console: no InvalidStateError (responseText) after accepting cookies - all brands and regions (Chrome)
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Chrome with DevTools available.
Steps:
1. Open the home page of each site and region: Hobbs (/, /au/, /us/, /row/), Phase Eight (/, /eu/, /de/, /au/, /row/), Whistles (/, /au/, /us/, /row/), Inside Story (/).
2. Open the DevTools console.
3. Accept the cookie banner.
4. Wait about 10 seconds and scroll the page a little.
5. Check the console error logs.
Expected: No "Uncaught InvalidStateError: Failed to read the 'responseText' property from 'XMLHttpRequest'... (was 'json')" error appears on any site or region.

Title: TFGTRS-4609 - Console: no InvalidStateError in Safari
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Safari (desktop or iOS) with the web inspector enabled.
Steps:
1. Open the home page of Hobbs, Phase Eight and Whistles in Safari.
2. Open the web inspector console.
3. Accept the cookie banner.
4. Wait about 10 seconds and check the console.
Expected: The error "InvalidStateError: The object is in an invalid state." does not appear.

Title: TFGTRS-4609 - Console: no InvalidStateError across a full journey - Hobbs and Phase Eight
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. Open the console.
2. Accept cookies.
3. Type a term in the search box to show suggestions.
4. Open a PLP and a PDP, select a size and add the product to the bag.
5. Open the bag and start the checkout.
6. Check the console after each step.
Expected: No InvalidStateError / responseText error is logged at any step.

Title: TFGTRS-4609 - Analytics tracking still works after the fix
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Network tab or Tag Assistant available.
Steps:
1. Open a product page and add a product to the bag.
2. Open the bag.
3. In the console run window.dataLayer and check the events; check the Network tab for Google Analytics and Contentsquare requests.
Expected: Analytics requests are sent (GA and Contentsquare) and dataLayer contains the expected events (for example view_cart). Nothing is missing compared with production.
